georef.vertical: game y = metres above CGVD2013 (HRDEM); ellipsoid height = y + anchor.hae, where anchor.hae is an approximate geoid height for Québec
georef.frame: game x = easting - georef.easting; game z = -(northing - georef.northing); -z is GRID north

sources.name: HRDEM Mosaic (CanElevation Series), terrain model
sources.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada.

rules.building_height: OSM height, else building:levels × 3.2 m, else by kind: church/cathedral/chapel 18 m, hotel/civic/school/university/government/public 16 m, garage/shed/hut/roof/kiosk 3 m, footprint over 1500 m² 15 m, footprint under 40 m² 4 m, otherwise 10.5 m (three storeys). `hs` says which: tag, levels or rule.
rules.roof: OSM roof:shape and roof:height where tagged; otherwise the loader chooses (see game/build/buildings.js).
rules.road_width: OSM width, else by class (ROAD_WIDTH in tools/build-scene.py).
rules.wall_height: OSM height, else city wall 6 m, retaining wall parapet 1.1 m, wall 2 m, fence and rails 1.1 m.
rules.water: OSM water polygons that close inside the data box; the river level is y = 0 (terrain cells under 0.8 m are river in HRDEM here).
rules.simplify: Rings and lines simplified to 0.25 m (Douglas-Peucker), coordinates rounded to 0.1 m.

terrain.encoding: base64 uint16 little-endian, rows north to south
